Title: Rinse filter
Description: Place the filter in the dripper and rinse it with hot water. Discard the water.

Title: Add coffee
Description: Add the ground coffee and shake gently to level the bed.

Title: Bloom
Description: Pour 40 ml of water over the grounds and let it bloom.

Title: Pour
Description: Pour the rest of the water in slow circles until you reach 300 ml.
